description: Option-pricing engine. Price European and American options and warrants (Black-Scholes, Black-76, CRR binomial, Garman-Kohlhagen FX, digital, range, share-based) and their greeks. Use this for a single contingent claim or warrant on one underlying; it does NOT price listed structured payoffs such as CBBCs, inline/derivative warrants or autocallables (use calculate_structured_product). Methods: black_scholes: spot, strike, maturity, risk_free, volatility, option_type; black76: forward, strike, maturity, risk_free, volatility, option_type; binomial_american: spot, strike, maturity, risk_free, volatility, option_type, steps; garman_kohlhagen: spot, strike, maturity, domestic_rate, foreign_rate, volatility, option_type; barrier_first_passage: spot, strike, maturity, risk_free, volatility, option_type, barrier, barrier_type; asian_average: spot, strike, maturity, risk_free, volatility, option_type, average_type; digital: spot, strike, maturity, risk_free, volatility, cash_payout; range: spot, lower_strike, upper_strike, maturity, risk_free, volatility, payout; share_based: share_price, exercise_price, expected_life, volatility, risk_free, dividend_yield. Supply exactly one method with its declared inputs (no defaults). An unknown method, a missing input, or an extra field returns an error envelope (code INVALID_ARGUMENT) instead of raising.

cash_payout.description: Fixed cash amount paid when the digital condition is met.

expected_life.description: Expected life of the award in years (IFRS 2).

maturity.description: Time to expiry in years (0.5 = six months); > 0.

method.description: Formula to apply; the tool description lists the exact inputs each value requires.

payout.description: Fixed payout when the range condition is met.

spot.description: Spot price of the underlying (or FX rate for garman_kohlhagen).

strike.description: Strike or exercise price in the same currency as spot.

name: calculate_option

outputSchema.description: Shared result envelope returned by every tool.

assumptions.description: Inputs and assumptions used, echoed for traceability.

data_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the underlying data, when fetched.

error.description: Error detail, present only when status='error'.

formula_ref.description: Formula or standards reference for the method.

method.description: Method or tool name that produced the result.

steps.description: Ordered computation steps, when the method reports them.

ticker.description: Ticker the result pertains to, when applicable.

value.description: Primary result: a number for scalar methods, an object for valuation methods.

title: Option and warrant pricing
